content: 九尾狐活动 纯剧情AVG序章
3:23 P.M. \ Clear

raw: Underneath a nondescript oak tree, outside the nomadic town of Wolumonde, Leithanien
content: Underneath a nondescript oak tree, outside the nomadic town of Wolumonde, Leithanien

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  Schultz Severin... This is your third pack of the day.
speaker: Tatjana
content: Schultz Severin... This is your third pack of the day.

speaker: Severin
content: Schultz?

speaker: Tatjana
content: Oh, sorry, Uncle...

raw: [name="Severin"]  I need my tobacco. You're right, of course. Alcohol and tobacco are bad habits. Don't be like me.
speaker: Severin
content: I need my tobacco. You're right, of course. Alcohol and tobacco are bad habits. Don't be like me.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  But your cough keeps getting worse.
speaker: Tatjana
content: But your cough keeps getting worse.

raw: [name="Severin"]  We're off the clock. No need to be so formal. How many times have I told you? Never mind.
speaker: Severin
content: We're off the clock. No need to be so formal. How many times have I told you? Never mind.

raw: He looks away. The burned tents, the weeds growing out of control. He flicks the ash from his cigarette.
content: He looks away. The burned tents, the weeds growing out of control. He flicks the ash from his cigarette.

raw: He hoped to find some peace and quiet in his solitude, even if it was just a change of his title.
content: He hoped to find some peace and quiet in his solitude, even if it was just a change of his title.

raw: [name="Severin"]  *Sigh*... They made you come all the way out here!
speaker: Severin
content: *Sigh*... They made you come all the way out here!

raw: [name="Severin"]  The bunch of old schemers. They won't even come to me themselves. They send out a little girl to get hurt——*Cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*!
speaker: Severin
content: The bunch of old schemers. They won't even come to me themselves. They send out a little girl to get hurt——*Cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*!

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  Calm down, Uncle! I volunteered. I thought it would be better to tell you myself.
speaker: Tatjana
content: Calm down, Uncle! I volunteered. I thought it would be better to tell you myself.

speaker: Severin
content: *Wheeze*——*cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*——

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  You really have to quit smoking and drinking. Look how bad you've gotten...
speaker: Tatjana
content: You really have to quit smoking and drinking. Look how bad you've gotten...

raw: [name="Severin"]  I've more or less figured it out. Damn it.
speaker: Severin
content: I've more or less figured it out. Damn it.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  Well, there was a heated discussion back in council. The young people hid in the parlor. No one dared to speak.
speaker: Tatjana
content: Well, there was a heated discussion back in council. The young people hid in the parlor. No one dared to speak.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  No, no one helped me. I couldn't convince anyone on my own. I'm sorry.
speaker: Tatjana
content: No, no one helped me. I couldn't convince anyone on my own. I'm sorry.

raw: [name="Severin"]  The situation has been tense since the town went off course. We don't need to be standing on ceremony anymore. Not that anyone would listen to students and kids, even if they did speak up.
speaker: Severin
content: The situation has been tense since the town went off course. We don't need to be standing on ceremony anymore. Not that anyone would listen to students and kids, even if they did speak up.

speaker: Severin
content: And then what happened?

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  The councilors agreed that because it was impossible to distinguish between Infected and the state of their infection, it's better safe than sorry...
speaker: Tatjana
content: The councilors agreed that because it was impossible to distinguish between Infected and the state of their infection, it's better safe than sorry...

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  The bodies need to be buried outside the town. And of course... no funerals.
speaker: Tatjana
content: The bodies need to be buried outside the town. And of course... no funerals.

speaker: Severin
content: *Sigh*...

speaker: Tatjana
content: I... I'm sorry...

raw: [name="Severin"]  But some of them are people of Wolumonde. Our own. We can't just abandon them.
speaker: Severin
content: But some of them are people of Wolumonde. Our own. We can't just abandon them.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Eckehard was the best tailor in town. He took over the shop from his father. We wouldn't have weddings without him.
speaker: Severin
content: Eckehard was the best tailor in town. He took over the shop from his father. We wouldn't have weddings without him.

raw: [name="Severin"]  And poor Biederman. He lost his job as a Catastrophe Messenger because of the Great Rift. But he's trying to atone. He is strong.
speaker: Severin
content: And poor Biederman. He lost his job as a Catastrophe Messenger because of the Great Rift. But he's trying to atone. He is strong.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Kevin wasn't Infected. He worked hard for his wife. He was a good husband.
speaker: Severin
content: Kevin wasn't Infected. He worked hard for his wife. He was a good husband.

speaker: Severin
content: And Thorwald, he——*cough* *cough*, *hack* *cough*——

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  No more smoking, Schultz. Thor even said so.
speaker: Tatjana
content: No more smoking, Schultz. Thor even said so.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Can you accept it, child? Honestly? Forget what the old schemers think.
speaker: Severin
content: Can you accept it, child? Honestly? Forget what the old schemers think.

speaker: Tatjana
content: I... I don't know...

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  I just want Thor to be buried so he can rest in peace. I don't want people treating him like he's a threat when he's already dead... to be tossed out there... to the elements.
speaker: Tatjana
content: I just want Thor to be buried so he can rest in peace. I don't want people treating him like he's a threat when he's already dead... to be tossed out there... to the elements.

speaker: Severin
content: Alright.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  Why do we have to treat them like that? We never did anything like that before.
speaker: Tatjana
content: Why do we have to treat them like that? We never did anything like that before.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  And that Oripathy doctor. She was incredible. She refused to abandon Wolumonde. All four of them have the right to a decent burial, but——
speaker: Tatjana
content: And that Oripathy doctor. She was incredible. She refused to abandon Wolumonde. All four of them have the right to a decent burial, but——

raw: [name="Severin"]  Putting them together with the Infected——
speaker: Severin
content: Putting them together with the Infected——

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  We should just be blaming the fire.
speaker: Tatjana
content: We should just be blaming the fire.

speaker: Severin
content: I know.

raw: [name="Severin"]  But... But let's save that for later. For now, we can't just dump their remains.
speaker: Severin
content: But... But let's save that for later. For now, we can't just dump their remains.

raw: [name="Severin"]  I contacted the nearest Gendarmerie, and they will have experts on the rescue team to assist with the investigation. Until then, we'll keep the bodies where I can care for them.
speaker: Severin
content: I contacted the nearest Gendarmerie, and they will have experts on the rescue team to assist with the investigation. Until then, we'll keep the bodies where I can care for them.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Once we have specialists on scene, we can treat the dead with appropriate care.
speaker: Severin
content: Once we have specialists on scene, we can treat the dead with appropriate care.

speaker: Tatjana
content: We can still get help?

raw: [name="Severin"]  They could be a month out, depending on the exact length of the rift. It could honestly be several months.
speaker: Severin
content: They could be a month out, depending on the exact length of the rift. It could honestly be several months.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  Wolumonde is getting worse and worse every day now that we're off course. Everyone is saying we'll have to head around the whole Great Rift to get back on track.
speaker: Tatjana
content: Wolumonde is getting worse and worse every day now that we're off course. Everyone is saying we'll have to head around the whole Great Rift to get back on track.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  But if the Great Rift is that big, if the detour is too long...
speaker: Tatjana
content: But if the Great Rift is that big, if the detour is too long...

speaker: Severin
content: Anyway, we have to wait.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Give me a minute with Thor. I think... I think I'm entitled to that.
speaker: Severin
content: Give me a minute with Thor. I think... I think I'm entitled to that.

raw: [name="Severin"]  If the old schemers want to leave my boy in the middle of nowhere, they'll have to shoot their own Schultz.
speaker: Severin
content: If the old schemers want to leave my boy in the middle of nowhere, they'll have to shoot their own Schultz.

speaker: Severin
content: They'll have to shoot me.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  They won't! We all know how much you've done for the town!
speaker: Tatjana
content: They won't! We all know how much you've done for the town!

speaker: Severin
content: ...No, forget I said that.

raw: [name="Severin"]  I can't say that at a time like this. The Schultz can't talk like that. We have work to do.
speaker: Severin
content: I can't say that at a time like this. The Schultz can't talk like that. We have work to do.

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  But Thor is still your son!
speaker: Tatjana
content: But Thor is still your son!

raw: [name="Severin"]  Tatjana, you go back and tell them. Tell them...
speaker: Severin
content: Tatjana, you go back and tell them. Tell them...

speaker: Severin
content: Tell them...

raw: [name="Severin"]  Tell them I agree. *Cough*. I agree with them.
speaker: Severin
content: Tell them I agree. *Cough*. I agree with them.

speaker: Severin
content: *Cough* *cough* cough*, *cough* *cough*——

speaker: Armed Infected
content: They came back.
Hm.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Thanks to the locals, we were able to slip into the nearby town and replenish our supplies.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Thanks to the locals, we were able to slip into the nearby town and replenish our supplies.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  The hunters will be back soon. Hope we get something today. I'm sick of sandworms. Two days is enough.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: The hunters will be back soon. Hope we get something today. I'm sick of sandworms. Two days is enough.
Hm.
How about water?

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Not an issue. Gotta thank them for that too.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Not an issue. Gotta thank them for that too.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  But seriously, I don't like talking to them. I always feel like they're looking down on me.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: But seriously, I don't like talking to them. I always feel like they're looking down on me.
Hm.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  It looks like Wolumonde is going to start migrating again soon. We have to see some results by then.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: It looks like Wolumonde is going to start migrating again soon. We have to see some results by then.

raw: [name="???"]  We have help. It will be good.
content: We have help. It will be good.

speaker: Armed Infected
content: Help...? Maybe.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  But I don't trust the local Infected. They're just out for revenge.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: But I don't trust the local Infected. They're just out for revenge.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Leithanien is better to the Infected than most places are. And since everyone here uses Arts, they don't have much reason to fear or persecute them.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Leithanien is better to the Infected than most places are. And since everyone here uses Arts, they don't have much reason to fear or persecute them.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  And isn't it enough that the Infected can have a decent life here without being sent straight to the gallows?
speaker: Armed Infected
content: And isn't it enough that the Infected can have a decent life here without being sent straight to the gallows?

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  I think they're just a bunch of thugs, stealing our name for their own purposes—
speaker: Armed Infected
content: I think they're just a bunch of thugs, stealing our name for their own purposes—
Name?
What's in... a name?

speaker: Armed Infected
content: Erm...

raw: [name="???"]  We don't trust them... fine. But... who do we trust? Who should we trust?
content: We don't trust them... fine. But... who do we trust? Who should we trust?

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Can you stop talking so creepily? Whatever you say, captain.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Can you stop talking so creepily? Whatever you say, captain.
...Thank you.

raw: [name="???"]  Oh, a leaf. It fell on your head...
content: Oh, a leaf. It fell on your head...

speaker: Armed Infected
content: Huh? What?

raw: [name="???"]  A few boxes of dried meat. Fresh-picked fruit. Water. It's early autumn. Still a long way to winter...
content: A few boxes of dried meat. Fresh-picked fruit. Water. It's early autumn. Still a long way to winter...
We have time.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Okay. You're still kind of confusing me with that talk.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Okay. You're still kind of confusing me with that talk.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Anyway, it's your call when to start the war.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Anyway, it's your call when to start the war.
War? No...

speaker: Armed Infected
content: Huh?
Look. The hunters are back.

raw: [name="???"]  Seems our food will be better tonight.
content: Seems our food will be better tonight.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  I hope so. We should eat more meat while we can. Food is going to be a big problem come winter.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: I hope so. We should eat more meat while we can. Food is going to be a big problem come winter.
Did Bob ever write back?

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Haven't heard from him since we got to Leithanien... Erm, by the way, I've been meaning to ask...
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Haven't heard from him since we got to Leithanien... Erm, by the way, I've been meaning to ask...

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Like, was his code name 'Bob' and they started calling him 'Big Bob' because he's a big guy, or was he 'Big Bob' from the start?
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Like, was his code name 'Bob' and they started calling him 'Big Bob' because he's a big guy, or was he 'Big Bob' from the start?
...I don't remember.

raw: [name="Armed Infected"]  Whatever. They're bounty hunters. Maybe they found the treasure.
speaker: Armed Infected
content: Whatever. They're bounty hunters. Maybe they found the treasure.
Treasure. Hm.

raw: [name="???"]  It would be nice... if there was a treasure to help us too.
content: It would be nice... if there was a treasure to help us too.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Folinic
content: It's been 27 days!

raw: [name="Folinic"]  How could she take so long to make contact? She's obsessed with punctuality!
speaker: Folinic
content: How could she take so long to make contact? She's obsessed with punctuality!

speaker: Folinic
content: Atro... where are you...?

speaker: Suzuran
content: Folinic?

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Oh, Lisa... Err, I'm supposed to call you Operator Suzuran now, huh?
speaker: Folinic
content: Oh, Lisa... Err, I'm supposed to call you Operator Suzuran now, huh?

speaker: Folinic
content: It's a good code name.

speaker: Suzuran
content: Hehe, thanks!

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  You've been watching the communication room for 20 hours now. Aren't you going to take a break?
speaker: Suzuran
content: You've been watching the communication room for 20 hours now. Aren't you going to take a break?

speaker: Folinic
content: Has it been that long?

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  Yes! So please go to the break room and get some rest. I'll take over for you.
speaker: Suzuran
content: Yes! So please go to the break room and get some rest. I'll take over for you.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Okay... It's really been that long...
speaker: Folinic
content: Okay... It's really been that long...

speaker: Suzuran
content: Still no word from Atro?

raw: [name="Folinic"]  None yet. I already put in an application to go to Leithanien. If Amiya approves, I'll leave right away.
speaker: Folinic
content: None yet. I already put in an application to go to Leithanien. If Amiya approves, I'll leave right away.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  Leithanien? Don't you have work to do?
speaker: Suzuran
content: Leithanien? Don't you have work to do?

raw: [name="Folinic"]  She's my classmate, and my best friend. I can't... I won't abandon her.
speaker: Folinic
content: She's my classmate, and my best friend. I can't... I won't abandon her.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Atro's last contact was with the office in northern Leithanien. Unless something big happened, she wouldn't go far from there.
speaker: Folinic
content: Atro's last contact was with the office in northern Leithanien. Unless something big happened, she wouldn't go far from there.

speaker: Suzuran
content: Then I'll go too!

speaker: Folinic
content: No.

speaker: Suzuran
content: Huh?! Harsh...

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  You- you just want to find Atro, right? It won't be dangerous?
speaker: Suzuran
content: You- you just want to find Atro, right? It won't be dangerous?

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Who knows what the situation could be.
speaker: Folinic
content: Who knows what the situation could be.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  That's okay! I'm a fully accredited operator now, and a student of Dr. Kal'tsit!
speaker: Suzuran
content: That's okay! I'm a fully accredited operator now, and a student of Dr. Kal'tsit!

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  And I can't stand seeing my big sister Folinic's worried face all the time! I have to do something!
speaker: Suzuran
content: And I can't stand seeing my big sister Folinic's worried face all the time! I have to do something!

raw: [name="Folinic"]  *Sigh*. I never imagined little Lisa would worry about me someday. Everything's all out of order lately.
speaker: Folinic
content: *Sigh*. I never imagined little Lisa would worry about me someday. Everything's all out of order lately.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  Big or small, we all have worries.
speaker: Suzuran
content: Big or small, we all have worries.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Well, okay! I reported in to the local branch office anyway. If anything goes wrong, they'll send help.
speaker: Folinic
content: Well, okay! I reported in to the local branch office anyway. If anything goes wrong, they'll send help.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Let's just wait for Amiya's approval and then we'll go together. But you'll have to stay close by me.
speaker: Folinic
content: Let's just wait for Amiya's approval and then we'll go together. But you'll have to stay close by me.

speaker: Suzuran
content: A message? Is it Atro?

raw: [name="Folinic"]  No. It's a brief, sent by an operator in Leithanien who received our message.
speaker: Folinic
content: No. It's a brief, sent by an operator in Leithanien who received our message.

speaker: Suzuran
content: Folinic?

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Atro was spotted in a small town in Leithanien... And about one month ago...
speaker: Folinic
content: Atro was spotted in a small town in Leithanien... And about one month ago...

speaker: Folinic
content: That town suffered a Catastrophe.
